caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with a rounded backrest and a circular seat, all crafted from a single piece of wood. The chair features a textured, rough surface with visible lines, cracks, and natural wood grain. Its color ranges from deep to medium brown, with darker shading indicating the depth in the backrest and seat area, and slightly lighter tones on the outer surfaces to highlight the contours. There are no other objects or background details present; the chair sits centered within a plain, light tan or beige frame, with the artist's signature and a number "35" visible at the bottom.
title: Wooden Log Chair
